instruction:
Account 16 still has cases marked Open -- please remind the responsible agents, one email per case with subject 'Case <id> reminder', starting with the case that has been open the longest.

Notification runbook (excerpt):
- One email per record, addressed to the responsible agent (the record's assigned agent; agent addresses follow the agentNN@atlas.com pattern and are listed in the agents table).
- Send the notifications one at a time in the required order, so the audit trail reflects the sequence.
- Do not modify any records while notifying.
expected_post_state: Four new outbox emails, in send order: case 54 (2025-01-13, agent 10), case 104 (2025-05-18, agent 9), case 81 (2025-09-11, agent 4), case 16 (2025-10-20, agent 7); no records modified.

provenance.source_benchmark: Author-constructed (Phase 2b family P, plan uncertainty); surface style follows WorkBench (Styles et al., 2024) and the archetype-F instances
provenance.adaptation: Instance designed by the author to isolate one plan-uncertainty axis (build decision IT-055): action count derivable from a read (a), action count dependent on runtime outcomes (b), unknown source tool (c), or ordering derived from record data (d). Entities reference the deterministic seed in seed_crm.py for stable post-state predicates. Paradigm implementations are reused unchanged from archetype F.
